data.name: Chasm Guide
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: With a single act of bravery, she went from expendable to indispensable.

data.name: Firemantle Mage
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control gain menace until end of turn. (A creature with menace can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
data.flavor_text: "Come on, you twisted things! Don't you want to get acquainted?"

data.name: Grovetender Druids
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, you may pay {1}. If you do, create a 1/1 green Plant creature token.
data.flavor_text: "The seedlings scream for us to loose them upon the Eldrazi, and we shall oblige."

data.name: Hero of Goma Fada
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: "They seek to break us. Let us show them our strength!"

data.name: Kalastria Healer
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
data.flavor_text: "Time and again, I have demonstrated my skills as a healer. Why, then, are you so ill at ease?"

data.name: Kor Bladewhirl
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control gain first strike until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: The high-pitched whirl of a hook is the only battle cry she needs.

data.name: Kor Entanglers
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, tap target creature an opponent controls.
data.flavor_text: "We came into this world together. We fight for this world together. We'll leave this world together."

data.name: Lantern Scout
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: Hedron lanterns fend off more than just the darkness.

data.name: Makindi Patrol
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control gain vigilance until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: Working with his noble mount, he notices every form on the horizon, every scent in the air, every tremor in the earth.

data.name: Munda, Ambush Leader
data.oracle_text:
Haste
Rally — Whenever Munda or another Ally you control enters, you may look at the top four cards of your library. If you do, reveal any number of Ally cards from among them, then put those cards on top of your library in any order and the rest on the bottom in any order.

data.name: Ondu Champion
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control gain trample until end of turn.
data.flavor_text:
"Put a minotaur at the head of an army and suddenly all the soldiers act like they have horns."
—Gideon Jura

data.name: Resolute Blademaster
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control gain double strike until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: "Great steel is born in the hottest forges. Great soldiers are born in war."

data.name: Tajuru Beastmaster
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: "My mount needs neither reins nor bridle. We both share a common purpose."

data.name: Tajuru Warcaller
data.oracle_text: Rally — Whenever this creature or another Ally you control enters, creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
data.flavor_text: Her rallying cry reaches far beyond the Tajuru elves, inspiring all those who hear it.
